component.name: downmark
component.summary: Lightweight Markdown editor with live preview

description.p: downmark is a fast Markdown editor with a live preview, built with GTK 4 and libadwaita.

ul.li: GitHub flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, footnotes, strikethrough
Export the rendered document as PDF or PNG

description.p: The selected tab is shaded instead of the inactive ones.
Only the tabs are shaded, the rest of the tab bar blends with the header.
Darker tab bar so tabs stand out from the header.

Tabs: every file opens as a tab in one window, new documents stay in memory until saved. Copy button on code blocks in the preview. Code highlighting in the editor always ends at the closing fence. The app ID is now io.github.SirOpolov.downmark.
Richer Markdown highlighting in the editor: sized headings, syntax highlighting inside fenced code blocks for 20 languages, dimmed table pipes and fences, task boxes, strikethrough and footnotes.
